repos.name: aws/aws-emulator
repos.description: AWS Emulator is a local emulator of the AWS APIs.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance local emulator for AWS APIs written in Rust.
bullets: Built in Rust for high concurrency and memory safety.
Provides local parity for AWS service APIs to accelerate development cycles.
Ideal for integration testing and local development environments without incurring cloud costs.
Reduces dependency on live cloud infrastructure during the CI/CD pipeline.

repos.name: openai/codex-security
repos.description: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security
repos.one_liner: An AI-powered security CLI and SDK for automated vulnerability detection and remediation.
bullets: Leverages OpenAI's Codex models to analyze codebases for security flaws.
Includes a TypeScript SDK for programmatic integration into existing security workflows.
Automates the validation and patching process for identified vulnerabilities.
Essential for DevSecOps teams looking to integrate AI-driven security checks into CI pipelines.

repos.name: onlyreadai/onlyread
repos.description: Make AI browser agents read-only: a Chrome extension that refuses writes (send, post, edit, delete) before they leave the browser.
repos.one_liner: A browser extension that enforces read-only constraints on AI agents to prevent unauthorized data modification.
bullets: Acts as a middleware layer between AI agents and web interfaces.
Intercepts and blocks write-heavy actions like posting, editing, or deleting data.
Enhances security for agentic workflows by preventing unintended side effects.
Useful for finance or enterprise professionals using AI agents to browse sensitive data.

repos.name: we-promise/sure
repos.description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
repos.one_liner: An open-source personal finance management application built for transparency and community collaboration.
bullets: Ruby-based architecture focused on clean, maintainable financial logic.
Provides a centralized dashboard for tracking personal assets, liabilities, and budgets.
Community-driven development model ensures privacy and feature alignment with user needs.
Suitable for individuals seeking a self-hosted or transparent alternative to commercial fintech apps.

repos.name: FrigadeHQ/yogurt
repos.description: Private AI meeting notes. Free and open source.
repos.one_liner: A private, open-source AI tool for generating and managing meeting notes.
bullets: TypeScript-based stack designed for local-first data processing.
Focuses on privacy-preserving AI transcription and summarization of professional meetings.
Reduces administrative overhead by automating the capture of action items and insights.
Ideal for teams requiring secure, private AI assistance for documentation and knowledge management.
